verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents its own Restricted API key type, which can be limited to selected operations, so least-privilege credentials exist first-party. It also documents an agent-oriented auth flow (register, user claim in browser, poll for access_token). The evidence is a single thin docs mention, though, and does not show how agent tokens are scoped. missing for 10: details of per-operation permission granularity, scoping of agent-issued access tokens, expiry/rotation/revocation controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Choose **Restricted** when an integration needs only selected operations; a restricted key with no permissions cannot call the API.
discover → register → deliver setup link & code to the user → user completes claim in browser → poll for access_token → call API.
